daily_summary.es: Resumen diario de noticias tecnológicas y de IA.
daily_summary.en: Daily summary of tech and AI news.

title.es: Apple lanza beta 2 para iPadOS 27.3, watchOS 27.3 y más
title.en: Apple releases beta 2 for iPadOS 27.3, watchOS 27.3, and more

body.es: Apple ha lanzado la segunda beta de iPadOS 27.3, watchOS 27.3, visionOS 27.3 y otros sistemas operativos. Esta actualización incluye mejoras en la estabilidad y rendimiento, preparándose para el lanzamiento final en 2027.
body.en: Apple has released beta 2 for iPadOS 27.3, watchOS 27.3, visionOS 27.3, and more. This update includes stability and performance improvements, preparing for the final release in 2027.

evidence.claim: Apple has released beta 2 for iPadOS 27.3, watchOS 27.3, visionOS 27.3, and more.

title.es: StarSling lanza su CI para repositorios de agentes
title.en: StarSling launches CI for agent-volume repos

body.es: StarSling ofrece un sistema de integración continua que acelera los flujos de trabajo en repositorios de código, con un promedio de 10x más rápido en tiempo de ejecución y un 70% menos de tiempo de ejecución de runners.
body.en: StarSling offers a continuous integration system that accelerates code repository workflows, with an average 10x speedup in runtime and 70% less runner time.

evidence.claim: StarSling's CI runners are 5.87 times faster than GitHub-hosted runners for Mastra's slowest workflow.
StarSling's agents can achieve an average 10x speedup in wall clock time with 70% less runner time.
StarSling offers a CI challenge where they will give $1,000 if their service cannot save at least 10% on your next CI bill.
StarSling's agents analyze workflows, run logs, and machine telemetry to propose and test optimizations, then ship the winner as a PR with benchmarks evidence.

title.en: How Cloudflare WAF helps protect against Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938)

body.es: Cloudflare ha lanzado reglas en su Managed Ruleset para detectar patrones de entrada Base64 malformados asociados con la vulnerabilidad Java4Shell, reduciendo la exposición mientras se aplican parches a los sistemas afectados.
body.en: Cloudflare has released new rules in its Managed Ruleset to detect malformed Base64 input patterns associated with the Java4Shell vulnerability, reducing exposure while patches are applied to affected systems.

evidence.claim: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) is a memory-corruption vulnerability in the Base64 decoder of OpenJDK.
The vulnerability allows remote code execution by overwriting memory next to the decoded output.
Cloudflare has released a new set of rules in the Cloudflare Managed Ruleset to detect malformed Base64 input patterns associated with this vulnerability.
The vulnerability affects Java runtimes OpenJDK 17.0.6 or newer, including distributions built from OpenJDK.
Cloudflare WAF can reduce exposure to the vulnerability while Java runtimes are being patched.

title.es: Actualizaciones fiscales para apps, compras in-app y suscripciones
title.en: Tax and price updates for apps, In-App Purchases, and subscriptions

body.es: Apple actualizará sus acuerdos para recoger y remitir impuestos en Botswana y Rwanda, y aplicará impuestos de ventas y uso en California para ciertas categorías de apps a partir de enero de 2027.
body.en: Apple will update its agreements to collect and remit taxes in Botswana and Rwanda, and apply sales and use taxes in California for certain app categories starting January 2027.

evidence.claim: Apple will collect and remit applicable taxes in Botswana and Rwanda.
Effective January 1, 2027, certain categories of apps will be subject to sales and use tax in California.

title.es: Nvidia deja de vender chips AI a China
title.en: Nvidia isn’t selling any more AI chips to China

body.es: Nvidia ha anunciado que dejará de vender chips Hopper H200 a China, tras haber luchado por la aprobación estadounidense para venderlos anteriormente. Esto se debe a preocupaciones sobre la debida verificación de empresas chinas que manejan los chips.
body.en: Nvidia has announced it will no longer sell Hopper H200 AI chips to China, after previously fighting for US approval to sell them. This is due to concerns about proper vetting of Chinese companies handling the chips.

evidence.claim: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress announced the cessation of H200 processor shipments to China during an earnings call.
Nvidia previously fought for US approval to sell H200 chips in China.
Nvidia's guidance does not include any licensed Hopper data center products for China.
There are concerns about the proper vetting of Chinese companies handling H200 AI chips.

title.es: El nuevo Apple TV duplica su memoria, pero las apps no pueden usarla
title.en: El nuevo Apple TV duplica su memoria, pero el sistema no deja que las apps la usen

body.es: El nuevo Apple TV 4K tiene 8 GB de RAM (el doble que el modelo anterior), pero las aplicaciones están limitadas a usar solo 2 GB de RAM, y el almacenamiento de 128 GB no puede ser usado por una sola aplicación.
body.en: The new Apple TV 4K has 8 GB of RAM (double the previous model), but apps are limited to using only 2 GB of RAM, and the 128 GB storage cannot be fully utilized by a single app.

evidence.claim: The new Apple TV has 8 GB of RAM, double the amount of the previous model.
Apps on the new Apple TV are limited to using only 2 GB of RAM, the same limit as the previous model.
The new Apple TV costs 120 euros more than the previous model, which had already increased by 60 euros in June 2026.
The new Apple TV has 128 GB of storage, but apps can only use up to 4 GB of it.
Apple TV's software limits the use of the extra RAM and storage, which may be resolved with a future software update.

title.es: Producción de pantallas para iPhone 18 y iPhone Air 2 comenzará pronto
title.en: iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 Display Production to Begin Soon Ahead of Expected March Launch

body.es: Los proveedores de pantallas de Apple están preparándose para comenzar la producción masiva de paneles OLED para el iPhone 18 y iPhone Air 2, con un lanzamiento esperado en marzo de 2027.
body.en: Apple's display suppliers are preparing to begin mass production of OLED panels for the iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2, with an expected March 2027 launch.

evidence.claim: Apple's display suppliers are preparing to begin mass production of OLED panels for the upcoming iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18.
Samsung Display and LG Display are expected to start mass production in late December and early January.
The iPhone Air 2 is expected to gain a second rear camera, with an Ultra Wide lens in addition to the Wide lens.
Apple is also likely to increase the battery life of the ultra-slim device, reduce the size of the Dynamic Island, and adopt Apple's 2nm A20 chip for speed and efficiency.

title.es: Ingeniería de inferencia para ingenieros de software

text.es: Las empresas tecnológicas están reduciendo el gasto en IA al moverse a modelos abiertos, lo que permite mayor control sobre la latencia y la disponibilidad de modelos.
text.en: Tech companies are reducing AI spend by moving to open models, allowing greater control over model latency and availability.

evidence.claim: Tech companies have reduced AI spend by moving to open models.
Inference providers can offer higher reliability guarantees than frontier labs.
Inference providers can offer more control over latency and model availability.
Fine-tuning a model’s quality is possible with inference providers.

title.es: 28 vulnerabilidades cero-day encontradas en dos días
title.en: 28 Zero-Day Findings in Under Two Days. Is Robotics Security Keeping Pace?

text.es: VicOne utilizó IA para encontrar 28 vulnerabilidades cero-day en herramientas de IA física, lo que plantea preguntas sobre si la seguridad robótica está manteniendo el ritmo.
text.en: VicOne used AI to find 28 zero-day vulnerabilities in Physical AI tools, raising questions about whether robotics security is keeping pace.

evidence.claim: VicOne used AI to find 28 zero-day vulnerabilities in Physical AI tools.

title.es: Startup afirma que su 'nariz AI' es tan buena como la humana
title.en: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s

text.es: Osmo afirma que su modelo de IA ha alcanzado una inteligencia olfativa humana en los últimos meses, y ya se está utilizando en la industria de fragancias para diseñar nuevos olores.
text.en: Osmo claims its AI model has achieved human-level olfactory intelligence in the last few months, and is already being used in the fragrance industry to design new scents.

evidence.claim: Osmo's AI model has achieved human-level olfactory intelligence in the last few months.
Osmo's technology is already being used in the fragrance industry to help brands design and manufacture new scents.
Osmo's AI model outperformed in-house perfumers at one of the world's largest consumer goods companies last month.
Osmo's technology has been used to create retail fragrances, including for giants like Procter & Gamble.
Osmo's technology has identified eight substances that were more repellent than DEET for the Gates Foundation.

title.es: MacPaw lanza su app de ciberseguridad Moonlock para iPhone
title.en: MacPaw's Moonlock Cybersecurity App Launches for iPhone

text.es: MacPaw ha lanzado su app Moonlock para iPhone, que incluye características como Scam Detect para verificar mensajes sospechosos y Security Score para evaluar la configuración de seguridad del dispositivo.
text.en: MacPaw has launched its Moonlock cybersecurity app for iPhone, featuring Scam Detect to check suspicious messages and Security Score to assess device security setup.

evidence.claim: MacPaw has launched its Moonlock cybersecurity app for the iPhone.
Moonlock includes a feature called Scam Detect that can check suspicious messages for signs of phishing.
Safe SMS is an opt-in feature that automatically filters out scam texts, with a record of what was caught and why.
Security Score provides a score from 0 to 100 that reflects the iPhone's security setup, and gives users recommendations on how they can improve it.
Email Breach History allows users to check whether their email address has turned up in a data breach.
